Zhang Yao-ren Promotional Headshot

Zhang Yao-ren, a Taiwanese actor born in 1988 and a graduate of Taipei National University of the Arts, is shown in a relaxed portrait wearing a blue T-shirt under a light striped jacket. His tousled dark hair and bright smile convey a friendly and approachable presence against a neutral gray background.

After joining the Qseries acting program in 2015, he appeared in Life Plan A and B and 1000 Walls in Dream. His leading role in What She Put on the Table in 2017 brought him wider recognition. sources.description:
Urban Casual Portrait

A young man in a patterned short-sleeve shirt and light jeans sits on a ledge outside a glass-fronted shop. He crosses one leg over the other, resting his hands on his knee, and looks pensively to the side. His black leather boots and the muted tones of his outfit complement the minimalist storefront behind him.

Through the window, a framed abstract artwork and a small wooden table with a teapot add subtle interior details. The overall mood is relaxed and contemplative, capturing a quiet moment in an urban setting.

Chang Yao-ren’s Casual Street Portrait

Actor Chang Yao-ren appears in a relaxed, candid shot on a quiet urban street. He wears a pink leopard-print short-sleeve shirt paired with light-wash jeans, one hand tucked into his pocket as he gazes toward the camera. The blurred backdrop of greenery and low-rise buildings suggests a residential neighborhood, lending an intimate, everyday feel to the image.
